decisions.reason: A same-message MODIFY already captures both the required user-fee insufficiency narrative and the projected status of the figures; no additional change is needed.
The source does not change the capex estimate, midpoint basis, provisional status, or shared-cost treatment.
The source states the investment-case conclusion but does not change financing assumptions, debt structure, or financing terms.
The statement that user fees are insufficient does not alter the selected operating-cost range or its source basis.
The source does not change the authoritative site list or the modeled network scope.
Requesting robust financial data for the investment case does not modify the existing data-review, error-checking, or modeling-quality requirements.
The source notes that figures remain projections but does not add or change an instruction about assumption annotation or source traceability.
The source changes the required investment-case message, not the model's presentation, simplicity, or auditability standard.
